notes.title: Pawns of WAR | NEXT HOTFIX VIEW
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Next hotfix 1.0.1.4 will add a complete redesign of all characters and weapons to the game.
This update will not introduce new content, it will only recycle the old one. After the release of this patch, we will move on to developing a seasonal update with a storyline, new characters, a new squad, and new weapons.

notes.title: ⚙️ Hotfix 1.0.1.3

tags.bug: *Fixed the "immortal machine gunner" when the enemy went into defense and kept shooting at the same time;

notes.title: ⚙️ Hotfix 1.0.1.2

tags.balance_change: *Missions have a 20% chance of becoming EASY, 50% of becoming NORMAL, 30% of becoming HARD;
*The maximum level for challenging missions does not exceed +8 levels from the player's current level;
*Reward multiplier x1 - for green missions, x2 - for yellow missions, x3 - for red missions (this does not apply to pawn or weapon rewards, everything is also 1 pc.);
*Reduced the reduction of the reward for the death of an allied pawn by half;
*The player can now get a mission lower than his level.;

*The opponent has a 2% chance to go into deep defense for 5 seconds, he does not attack, but damage does not pass through him, in this case it is better to click on another enemy so that the allied pawns do not shoot empty;

tags.bug: *Fixed the display of the "weapon ability" parameter, now it is displayed only for weapons that have any special property.

tags.balance_change: *Daily boss's health has been increased to 2000

tags.feature: +The "NATASHA" pawn can now heal allied pawns by 50 health points every 10 seconds;
+Hidden Achievement can now be obtained by clicking on the developers tab.
-Removed the parameter "can hide", "rarity" in the pawn inventory;
-The "Range" parameter of the weapon has been removed;
